description: Controlled card corpus for the PostgreSQL hybrid retrieval baseline.

cards.body: Version one includes employee onboarding, manager approval, account provisioning, and access revocation. Payroll calculation and international payments are excluded.
Human Resources is the source of truth for worker status.
Every worker receives a unique workforce identifier, and an identifier is never reused after the worker leaves.
Directory provisioning is retried at most three times; after the third failure, the request enters manual review.
Privileged access requires approval from both the line manager and Security Operations.
Every provisioning attempt records its timestamp, outcome, and correlation identifier.
Elena Park is executive sponsor, Omar Haddad is delivery lead, and architecture decisions require Architecture Council review.
SEC-AUTH-017 requires phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication for privileged administrators and a 15-minute inactivity timeout.
INT-DIR-204 uses an X-Idempotency-Key header; HTTP 429 is retried with exponential backoff capped at 60 seconds, while HTTP 400 is not retried.
Audit records are retained for seven years and exported as JSON Lines.
